description_zh: 该接口用于查询数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-meta-db --project-id 123 --data-source-type emr --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id abc --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMetaDB

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks 工作空间的 ID。您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html 获取工作空间 ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Set the value to emr
parameters.help_zh: 数据类型，当前仅支持取值为emr
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the E-MapReduce (EMR) cluster. You can log on to the EMR console (https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou) to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: EMR集群的ID。您可以登录EMR的控制台 (https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou)，获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id
